definitions.gloss: suspicion of a crime; charge; accusation
definitions.explanation: Suspicion that someone has committed a crime, or the formal charge brought against them. A legal and journalistic term frequently seen in news reports.

examples.japanese: {窃盗|せっとう}の{嫌疑|けんぎ}をかけられた。
{嫌疑|けんぎ}が{晴|は}れて{釈放|しゃくほう}された。
examples.english: The suspicion was cleared and they were released.

examples.japanese: {殺人|さつじん}の{嫌疑|けんぎ}で{逮捕|たいほ}された{男|おとこ}は{容疑|ようぎ}を{否認|ひにん}している。
examples.english: The man arrested on suspicion of murder denies the charges.

notes: A formal/legal term. Not to be confused with homophone {建議|けんぎ} (formal recommendation). Related terms: {容疑|ようぎ} (suspicion, used in {容疑者|ようぎしゃ} — suspect), {被疑者|ひぎしゃ} (suspect, legal term). Common collocations: {嫌疑|けんぎ}をかける (to cast suspicion on), {嫌疑|けんぎ}が{晴|は}れる (suspicion is cleared), {嫌疑|けんぎ}{不十分|ふじゅうぶん} (insufficient evidence for charges), {嫌疑|けんぎ}なし (no grounds for suspicion).
